summary.title: Scenario 2
summary.description:
Scenario 2 (Medium): Third-Party API Integration
Background

An e-commerce platform integrates with a third-party payment gateway to process customer transactions. The platform’s backend sends payment requests to the gateway over a REST API using API keys for authentication. Transaction results are stored in an internal database and displayed to customers via the frontend. The platform also sends order confirmation emails through a third-party email service.
Task
1. Create a Data Flow Diagram in OWASP Threat Dragon for the entire transaction and notification flow. Your diagram must include trust boundaries separating internal systems from both third-party services.
2. Identify at least six distinct threats covering a minimum of five STRIDE categories.
3. For each threat, provide:
• Threat title, STRIDE category, and severity rating (Low / Medium / High).
• Description of how the threat manifests.
• Proposed mitigation and justification.
4. Identify and discuss one trust boundary violation visible in the DFD and explain its security implications.
